disabledOn.description: The machines it stays off, replacing those it did.

enabled.description: Off takes it off every machine.

names.description: The skills to import, by name, as the listing gives them.

source.description: A GitHub repository, as owner/repo or its URL.

files.description: The skill's folder, with a SKILL.md at its root.

source.description: A GitHub repository, as owner/repo or its URL.

name.description: The subdomain, instead of the random id.
name.patternDescription: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, at most 40, not starting or ending with a dash

password.description: Asked for by the proxy as Basic auth, any user name.

port.description: The dev server's, on the machine running the command.

ttl.description: Seconds until the preview stops by itself; 8 hours when left out.

retryAfter.description: Seconds until trying again is worth it, as in the Retry-After header.

names.description: The skills to update; every imported one when left out.

get.description: The instructions and skills `sloppa agents sync` brings to the machines, and how each machine last synced.

put.description: Replaces the instructions every machine gets in ~/.agents/AGENTS.md.
Replaces the instructions only this machine gets, after the shared ones. Blank removes them.

post.description: Imports skills from a GitHub repository's default branch. A skill by the same name is replaced, and follows the repository from then on.
Brings imported skills up to date with their repositories. A repository that can't be read fails its skills only.

delete.description: Deletes a skill: machines remove it the next time they sync.

patch.description: Turns a skill on or off, everywhere or on some machines.

put.description: Saves a skill's folder as uploaded, replacing the skill by that name if there is one. It's then no longer updated from a repository.

post.description: The skills in a GitHub repository's default branch, to pick from for importing.

get.description: What the machine whose token this is should have: its composed instructions, and its skills by version.

post.description: What `sloppa agents sync` did, for the dashboard to show.

parameters.description: Matches name, id, collection or content type, case-insensitively.
parameters.name: q

schema.description: Matches name, id, collection or content type, case-insensitively.

post.description: Uploads files into a collection. The collection field must come before the files, and each file can be at most 100 MiB. When one file fails, none are kept.

get.description: Needs no sign-in: the random id is what makes a shared link unguessable.

patch.description: Files an artifact under another collection; its links stay the same.

post.description: A machine made by hand, for a script or a computer the setup prompt doesn't fit. Its token is shown once.

delete.description: Deletes the machine and its token, which ends the previews it started.

post.description: Makes a preview `sloppa preview run` then connects its tunnel to, with the same credentials.

get.description: A WebSocket (subprotocol sloppa-tunnel.v1) carrying yamux, from `sloppa preview run` to the server, with the credentials that started the preview.

post.description: A link that registers one machine, with `sloppa setup`, within 30 minutes, and the prompt that has an agent do it.
